main.description: A subscription to a content source, identified by the source union: an RSS/Atom feed or a Standardfeed publication.

source.description: Identity of the subscribed source. Open union; readers tolerate unknown variants.

title.description: Display title. Auto-prefilled from the source, user-editable.

tags.description: Free-form, user-defined tags. No controlled vocabulary.

primary.description: Whether the source receives special treatment in the digest.

siteUrl.description: Human-facing site URL associated with the feed.

publication.description: AT-URI of the site.standard.publication record. This subscription is a metadata sidecar; the paired site.standard.graph.subscription record is the existence authority.
